findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_store_info" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Everything an Israeli business on AgentFeed says about itself, not about one item: what the business is, where it is, its capacity, what is included, its polici…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product, build_cart · Public sink: search_products, start_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product, build_cart · Public sink: search_products, start_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
